v2-sq-l.note: T2 Q75 V2-SQ-L: a numbered room's ordinal ('Bedroom two £500', 'bedroom 2 £500') is never part of an amount nor beside one. One helper, hideRoomNumbers in room-words.ts, blanks the ordinal (same length) only when a stated amount (£ or digits) follows; amounts(), plainPrice and totals() read through it; saidAmountOpen is unchanged. Core's span check treats a number word that ends one of the job's own room names as the room. Base SQ-K #1049 at 179a8e674. No route, table or migration. Golden record: parser hash only.
